source_authority: Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
source_title: Approved Colleges / Approved Institutions lists by pharmacy course
scope: PCI's separate institution approval lists for degree and diploma courses under section 12, Pharm.D, Pharm.D post-baccalaureate, M.Pharm, and other separately linked course/only-for-conduct lists.
scope_caveats: PCI states its approved-institution list is updated regularly; there is no common dated snapshot for all course pages.
Approval to conduct a course and approval under section 12 are distinct; preserve the exact approval scope, course, intake and academic session.
Do not infer a negative approval from absence on one course-specific page.
acquisition_caveat: The official index and page labels were verified, but this task did not obtain a complete consolidated export. The public pages did not expose a stable machine-readable national roster in the browser output; direct shell acquisition was unavailable. This file contains source references only, not pharmacy approvals.
